description: Synthetic LLM-serving front end over gRPC on localhost. No model, no GPU: each scheduler step sleeps fixed + per_seq*batch + prefill*new_seqs microseconds.

environment.note: localhost only; synthetic compute (sleep per scheduler step); client and server share the machine

aggregation: median [min-max] across repetitions; each repetition uses a different arrival seed

definitions.goodput_rps: requests that received all tokens before their deadline, divided by the arrival window
definitions.latency/ttft: measured by the client from the *scheduled* arrival time (open loop, corrects coordinated omission)
definitions.rejected: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED at admission (queue full, would-miss-deadline, or over adaptive limit)
definitions.tokens_wasted: tokens the server generated for requests that then did not complete
